justification: Both depict large-scale relief human figures in profile with raised arms, rendered in a conventionalised, flat, outline-and-detail manner with patterned garments and dense filler ornament, which is a generic correspondence. But the specific content differs entirely: A shows a solar disc with radiating hands, royal couple and children beneath, flanked by cartouches and dense registers of script, while B shows a single winged, bird-headed figure amid rosette-covered branches with no script, disc, or multi-figure scene.
